content.text:
## Verdict

Single-column because layout is intentionally capped at X’s **550px embed width** (`.eco-feed-timeline { max-width: 550px }`) and each post is a **direct `Tweet.html` iframe**, not native cards / masonry. Native masonry (`column-count: 3`) was replaced in-session for “live embeds”; that version is **not in git** (files are still `??` / untracked).

---

## Paths (1-line each)

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/app/components/ecosystem-feed.tsx` | Client feed: filters, infinite scroll, `TweetEmbed` → iframe |
| `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/lib/x-widgets.ts` | Builds `platform.twitter.com/embed/Tweet.html?…&width=550` (+ unused `bindXEmbedResize`) |
| `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/app/globals.css` | `.eco-feed*` layout (~L1735–1789): timeline max 550px, no masonry |
| `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/app/api/ecosystem-feed/route.ts` | Proxy to intel `/api/feed`; in-memory 20s + `cache-control: public, max-age=15` |
| `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/app/ecosystem-explorer.tsx` | Mounts `<EcosystemFeed />` under “Build on Meteora DBC →” (~L558) |
| `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/app/page.tsx` | Homepage → `EcosystemExplorer` |
| `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/lib/http-cache.ts` | Pad JSON cache helpers — **not** used by ecosystem-feed |
| `/Users/semi/Vibecode/meteco/.cursor/plans/x-official-embeds.md` | Decision: official embeds → single-column 550px (explicitly dropped masonry) |
| `/Users/semi/Vibecode/meteco/.cursor/plans/live-embed-feed.md` | Switch from stored text/media cards → live X embeds |
| `/Users/semi/Vibecode/meteco/.cursor/plans/meteora-fyi-feed-chrome.md` | Prior native chrome: CSS `column-count` masonry |
| `/Users/semi/Vibecode/meteco/meteora-intel/src/site-html.ts` | Separate intel HTML: flex 3-col masonry native cards (hides cols at breakpoints) |

**Restore native from transcript (not git):** parent chat `2e685511-…` tool Write ~L493 (full native `FeedCard` + `.eco-feed-masonry`) and ~L631 (paginated native rewrite). CSS snapshot: `.eco-feed-masonry { column-count: 3 }` / `2` @768 / `1` @520.

---

## Current layout CSS

- **Not masonry.** Container: `.eco-feed-timeline { max-width: 550px; margin: 0 auto }` — one vertical stack.
- Embeds: `width: 100%; max-width: 550px`; default height ~280px until postMessage resize.
- Mobile ≤768: timeline `max-width: 100%` (still one column).
- Leftover: `.eco-card:focus-visible` in CSS but **no `.eco-card` markup** anymore.

---

## How tweets mount

- **Iframe**, not native cards, not `blockquote` + `widgets.js` (comment at top of `ecosystem-feed.tsx` is stale).
- `src={xEmbedSrc(id)}` → `https://platform.twitter.com/embed/Tweet.html?...&theme=dark&width=550&hideThread=true`.
- Mount only when **IntersectionObserver** says near viewport (`rootMargin: "120px"`); off-screen = empty `.eco-x-slot`.
- Height via `postMessage` from twitter/x origins → `heightCache` Map.
- `bindXEmbedResize()` in `x-widgets.ts` is **dead** (never called).
- Client only keeps `{ id, url }` from API even though route still types full post fields.

---

## `/api/ecosystem-feed` cache

- Server Map TTL **20s**; response header **`cache-control: public, max-age=15`**.
- `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"`.
- Client fetch uses **`cache: "no-store"`**.
- No Redis (plan mentioned 5 min Redis; not implemented). Upstream: `$METEORA_INTEL_URL/api/feed`.

---

## Lag sources (obvious)

1. **Each on-screen tweet = full Tweet.html widget** (mini X app) — main cost.
2. **IO remount/unmount** of iframes as you scroll (+ height message listeners per active embed).
3. **Infinite scroll:** section lazy-load IO → page fetch (`PAGE = 8`) → sentinel IO (scroll-armed).
4. **No `widgets.js` currently** — that path was abandoned; direct iframes only.
5. Pagination is light; lag is **embed runtime**, not JSON size.

---

## Restore native/masonry without guessing

Touch only:

1. `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/app/components/ecosystem-feed.tsx` — restore `FeedCard` + `.eco-feed-masonry` (use full `Post` fields from API again).
2. `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/app/globals.css` — replace `.eco-feed-timeline` / `.eco-x-*` with `.eco-feed-masonry` + `.eco-card*` (3/2/1 columns).
3. Optional: drop or ignore `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/lib/x-widgets.ts`.

Do **not** use intel `site-html.ts` masonry as-is for fyi — that version `display:none`s columns on narrow viewports; RWAScreener native used CSS columns so all cards stay visible.
